$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the fields of a Levea edit request. Edit only this file, then run `node scripts/sync-contract.mjs`. Every client (mcp-server, OpenClaw plugin, Hermes plugin) builds BOTH its tool input schema and its backend request body by looping over these fields, and the skills / OpenAPI docs are generated from it. `node scripts/sync-contract.mjs --check` fails CI and publishing when any copy is stale. placement: 'param' -> body.params[name]; 'top' -> body[name]; 'project' -> body.projectId and body.project_id. surfaces: where the field is exposed (all: autonomous_edit / video_edit tools; queue: queue_edit tools — only fields /queue-edit actually reads; openapi: ChatGPT action spec).

fields.name: prompt
fields.doc: Description of the video edit to perform, in the user's own words.

schema.description: Natural-language description of the desired edit or creative brief. The backend planner decomposes it into canonical actions (viral clips, captions, reframe, export, …). Send the user's intent verbatim — do not pre-decompose.

fields.name: project_id
fields.doc: Project identifier returned by a prior call; reuse it for every follow-up edit on the same video.

schema.description: Optional project id for tracking and continuity. Reuse the projectId returned by the first call for every continuation.

fields.name: video_url
fields.doc: Public source video URL when starting a new project.

schema.description: Optional public source video URL (HTTP/HTTPS: S3, Google Drive public link, Dropbox, direct MP4) for a new project. Local file paths are not supported.

fields.name: assets
fields.doc: Input media (video, image, audio) as public HTTP/HTTPS URLs.

schema.description: Optional input media assets. URLs must be public HTTP/HTTPS links.

url.description: Publicly accessible HTTP/HTTPS URL to the video, image, or audio asset.

fields.name: scene
fields.doc: Existing scene/timeline state to continue editing (advanced).

schema.description: Optional existing scene/timeline state to continue editing (advanced).

fields.name: captionTemplatePreset
fields.doc: Caption template id to apply: a builtin slug (e.g. `hormozi`, `viral-pop`, `karaoke`) or a saved template id. Call `list_caption_templates` for the exact ids.

schema.description: Optional caption template to apply when (re)generating captions: a builtin slug (e.g. hormozi, mrbeast, viral-pop, karaoke, neon-pop, subtitle-bar) or a user-saved template id. Call list_caption_templates for the exact ids available.

fields.name: requirePlanApproval
fields.doc: When `true`, pause after planning and return `workingMemory` for the user to approve.

schema.description: If true, the backend stops after planning and returns workingMemory for user approval. Resend with workingMemory (and optionally editedPlan) to continue.

fields.name: workingMemory
fields.doc: State returned by a paused plan-approval call; send it back to resume.

schema.description: Working memory returned by an awaiting-approval call; resend it to resume.

fields.name: editedPlan
fields.doc: The user's edited version of a plan returned by an approval pause.

schema.description: Optional pre-edited plan object returned by a prior awaiting_approval response.

fields.name: attachedImages
fields.doc: Reference image URLs for planning (style, branding).

schema.description: Optional reference image URLs used for planning.

fields.name: flaggedIssues
fields.doc: Specific problems the user flagged that this run must fix.

schema.description: Optional list of specific user-flagged problems for this run (e.g. ["caption #3 misspelled"]).

fields.name: brandId
fields.doc: Brand kit to apply to this call.

schema.description: Optional per-call brand profile id (see list_brand_kits).

fields.name: projectBrandId
fields.doc: Default brand kit for the project; persists across calls.

schema.description: Optional default brand for the project. Persists; per-call brandId overrides.

fields.name: core_only
fields.doc: Return only rendering-essential scene fields (smaller responses).

schema.description: Return rendering-essential scene fields only (smaller payloads).

fields.name: platforms
fields.doc: Export platforms for the queued edit (e.g. `tiktok`, `reels`, `youtube_shorts`).

schema.description: Optional export platforms for the queued edit.

fields.name: autoExport
fields.doc: Export automatically when the queued edit finishes.

schema.description: Automatically export after the queued edit.
